# Site Zones

> Click through an interactive hazardous waste site plan: exclusion zone, contamination reduction zone, support zone, access control points, the decon corridor and wind direction.

Site Zones (https://site-zones.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, Supervisor training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://site-zones.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://site-zones.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). Site control in depth. Enroll: https://site-zones.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Supervisor Training](https://site-zones.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training): $69.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(4). Setting and enforcing zones. Enroll: https://site-zones.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training?buy=597

## Guides

- [Setting up site control zones](https://site-zones.hazwoperosha.us/guides/setting-up-site-control-zones): How a site safety officer lays out the hot, warm and cold zones on a new site.
- [When the wind shifts: adjusting zones on the fly](https://site-zones.hazwoperosha.us/guides/when-the-wind-shifts): Zones are built around the wind. Here's what happens when it changes.
